concerns.text: The plan proposes statistical testing of `review_effort_duration` between human and LLM‑generated code, but it never specifies how `review_effort_duration` will be obtained for the synthetic LLM cohorts. In Research.md the outcome metric is defined only for real PRs ("first_reviewer_comment_timestamp – merge_timestamp"). Without actual human review timestamps for LLM‑generated snippets, the measurement lacks construct validity, making the causal/associational claim unsound.
